comments.text: We on fixed income are living like in prison. My only advice to all of you young folks. Save as much money as you can for retirement. Do not think you will die young. You will not. Doctors will keep you life as long as they can get money from you. They always can. Do not buy anything you really do not need. No vocations or fun stuff, stay from subscriptions as much as you can. Buy gold on cheap, research. Getting old is the most expensive thing in your life. Look how many people at old age are broke, living with kids and so on.
